caseName: Weyerhaeuser Co. v. Lyman Lamb Co.
caseNameFull: Weyerhaeuser Co. v. Lyman Lamb Co. and Georgia-Pacific Corp. v. Lyman Lamb Co.

opinions.text:
C. A. 5th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 456 U. S. 971.] Motion of Alaska et al. for leave to participate in oral argument as amici curiae and for additional time for oral argument denied. Motion of National Lumber & Building Material Dealers Association for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted.

Justice White took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.
